id_and_class.theory_title: Hobbes’s Mechanical Phantasms and the Material Mind
id_and_class.summary: Thomas Hobbes holds that whatever exists is body and whatever changes is motion, so sensation, imagination, memory, thought, and emotion are all motions in a living organism. Pressure from an external body travels inward to the brain and heart and provokes an outward counter-motion, or ‘endeavour’, and the felt appearance of color, sound, or pain (the ‘phantasm’) just is that motion. There is no immaterial soul and, for Hobbes, no explanatory gap.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Phenomenal Appearance as Motion in the Body

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: A phantasm, the felt content of sensation, is identical with a reactive motion in the perceiver’s body. Appearance is real, wholly corporeal, and nothing over and above that motion.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Mind-body identity: mental states are motions in a body, so questions of union or interaction never arise. Hobbes calls ‘incorporeal substance’ a contradiction, two names with inconsistent meanings that together signify nothing.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Weak emergence (mental life is organized motion in living bodies, with no residue beyond the motion)
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: The outward direction of the counter-motion is why appearances seem to be of a world outside rather than of the sense organ. Hobbes uses ‘conscious’ only in its old public sense, of two or more people knowing the same fact, and treats private conscience as a metaphor.
conceptual_ground.qualia_account: Colors, sounds, and heat are not in objects; in objects they are motions of matter, and in us they are also motions. Hobbes goes beyond Galileo’s demotion of secondary qualities by identifying the appearance itself with a bodily motion.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: Bodies with magnitude and place, motion, and pressure transmitted through nerves to the brain and heart. Nothing incorporeal.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: We take notice of sense through sense itself and through the memory it leaves, since ‘he that perceives that he has perceived, remembers’.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: Sense is the original phantasm; imagination is decaying sense; memory is the same decaying motion noticed as past; dreams are imagination in sleep; trains of thought are sequences of such motions in the order they were first produced.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Sensation, imagination, memory, dreaming, deliberation, passion, and reasoning.
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: Pressure and endeavour: an external body presses a sense organ, the pressure travels inward to the brain and heart, and the heart’s outward counter-pressure produces the phantasm, which persists for a while after the object is gone.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Mental life is one continuous dynamics of motions that persist, weaken, and follow one another in the order they were first produced. Dreams are vivid because no external motions compete with them.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: In the sense organs, nerves, brain, and heart of a living body.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: Motions cause motions, so phantasms take part in the same causal order as everything else. Reasoning is ‘reckoning’, computation with names, and language greatly amplifies human cognition beyond what animals share.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: Retention binds experience over time: without memory nothing could be compared or distinguished, and sensing the same thing always would be the same as sensing nothing.
mechanism_and_dynamics.information_flow_or_representation: All conceptions originate in sensation. Imagination stores and recombines sensory contents, and linguistic signs allow more elaborate thought.
core_claims_and_evidence: Sense is nothing but original fancy caused by the pressure of external things on the sense organs.
Mirrors and echoes separate an appearance from its source, showing that sensible qualities are in the perceiver rather than the object.
Inferring an incorporeal thinker from ‘I am thinking’ is like inferring an incorporeal walker from ‘I am walking’ (Hobbes’s objection to Descartes).
Awareness requires difference: sensing the same thing always and not sensing at all come to the same.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Philosophical: mechanistic natural philosophy, empiricist psychology, and argument against Cartesian dualism.

empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: If sense is reaction to pressure and all bodies react, all bodies should sense; Hobbes’s restriction to bodies with organs and memory looks contrived, and Sorell concludes some panpsychism is hard to rule out (Cavendish and Henry More pressed the same point). Leijenhorst reads phantasms as modes of the perceiver rather than identities with motion, a reading Duncan questions.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: Hobbes asserts rather than argues that phantasms are motions and never asks why motion should feel like anything. His discrimination requirement is never developed into a criterion for which bodies sense.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Fully consistent with his corporealism, and it sets the shape of the later materialist program, including mind-brain identity theory.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Since every mental state is a motion in a body and incorporeal substance is a contradiction, nothing of the mind continues once the body’s motions stop.
